device.description: 16-bit single-channel voltage-output DAC (external reference, VFB feedback pin) with 24-bit SPI-compatible write-only interface and power-down
device.note: dac8551.pdf (SLAS429E) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions (VDD 2.7-5.5 V, digital inputs 0-VDD), p.7 timing characteristics and Figure 1 serial write operation (SYNC falls with SCLK high, data clocked on SCLK falling edges), p.17 power-on reset (DAC register zero), p.18 power-down modes (Table 1) and serial interface, p.19 input shift register (Figure 49) and SYNC interrupt (Figure 50)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC register; p.17 power-on reset fills it with zeros (0 V output)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: PD1/PD0 (DB17/DB16) of the last valid frame, Table 1 (00 normal, 01 1 kohm, 10 100 kohm, 11 Hi-Z)

commands.name: WRITE
commands.note: Figure 49: DB23-DB18 unused, DB17-DB16 PD1/PD0, DB15-DB0 data; executed on the 24th SCLK falling edge; SYNC high before it aborts the frame (SYNC interrupt, p.19)

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (VDD 2.7-5.5 V, digital inputs), p.7 (timing, Figure 1), p.17 (power-on reset), p.18 (power-down Table 1, serial interface), p.19 (input shift register Figure 49, SYNC interrupt Figure 50)
notModeled: analog output, resistor string and output amplifier (VOUT never driven)
power-down output loads (1 kohm / 100 kohm / Hi-Z): PD1/PD0 stored in CTRL.PD only
power-up time from power-down (2.5-5 us) and output settling
SCLK frequency (30 MHz / 20 MHz) and setup/hold limits t1-t9
variants: dac8551.pdf covers only the DAC8551 (A grade DAC8551IA = tighter specs, same interface). DAC8550 is the two's-complement-coded version; DAC8560 adds a 2.5-V internal reference.
